observed: The root opens SAGUNTUM · Sagunto y Puerto de Sagunto with 31 places and 6 regions.
The places catalogue retains its 31 entries and opens Vía del Pòrtic under #portic.
The Pòrtic notebook exposes twenty stops, six groups, route, chronology, sources and related visits.
The plan dialog exposes all twenty numbered stops and selects the cloaca with the deep link #portic/portic-cloaca.
The selected cloaca map identifies Espacio arqueológico and sixteen basement stops.
The chronology tab displays the eighteen dated events and source controls.
The sources tab displays nineteen attributed source links and methodology.
The ARSE 2005 source dialog displays author, year, page references and the original source link.
Returning to the whole site restores the full twenty-stop map.
Without WebGL, 3D mode controls are disabled and the documentation/map remain usable.
limitations: No live GPU rendering, free camera navigation or GPU performance measurement was possible in this browser.
The 3D geometry, camera positions and mode controls were validated separately using the production model and Three.js.
Rendered PNGs use exported model geometry in Blender CPU; lighting and antialiasing differ from the live WebGL renderer.
